Theme

Town, shops & places · Money, work & business

for sale phrase

also put up for sale, marketable, saleable, on sale

classical

Traupman 131
Traupman 69

vēnālis, vēnāle

adjective, third declension

Other words

  • vēneō, vēnīre — be for sale

    verb, fourth conjugation · classical · Traupman 131

  • vēnālīcius, vēnālīcia, vēnālīcium — for sale

    declension · also used · classical · Petr. 76 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 131

  • vēnum dare — put up for sale, sell

    the accusative vēnum, “to sale”, with dare · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. vēnum; Traupman 131

  • vēndibilis, vēndibile — saleable, marketable

    declension · also used · classical · Cic. Agr. 2.36; Hor. Ep. 1.17.47 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 131

Examples

  • Quid enim illīc nōn vēnībat?

    For what wasn’t for sale there?composed

  • Hae aedēs sunt vēnālēs.

    This house is for sale.Traupman 373

See also sell, display, sold out.
